card.name: Odd characters inside split words
card.fires_on: Fires on a rare accented letter or a broken-character byte in the middle of a word or table dash, and on the final piece of the brand name ICLUSIG. It also fires on special letters in place names.

modes.label: Accented letters in names
modes.description: A special Latin letter inside a foreign place name or its transliteration.

modes.label: Broken dash character
modes.description: A garbled character standing in for a dash in drug interaction lists.

modes.label: End of ICLUSIG
modes.description: The last piece of the brand name ICLUSIG in dosing instructions.
